text: Running the real tui shell confirmed the pure-Rust stack renders (real C-ABI `nmp_app_open_feed` + `compose_chirp_runtime` + `Difference(follows,mute)` + `decode_op_feed_snapshot` all surface the notes). So the break is host-side — and I found it: BOTH the generated iOS `ProjectionCache.generated.swift:177` and the Android `ProjectionCache.kt:194` (the NMP-owned rev-aware host apply caches) skip a `Changed` row when `incomingRev <= cached.rev`. App-owned keys like `chirp.timeline.home` emit `projection_rev = 0` on EVERY tick (they're absent from the kernel's builtin rev manifest — `rung2_stamp.rs:31-33`). So the host commits the FIRST (empty) home-feed frame at rev 0, then skips every later card-bearing frame (`0 <= 0`) → frozen empty while the envelope rev (your "decodedRev") climbs to 26. That is exactly "decodedRev advanced to 26 yet no card."
